_source: Figma file 'Design system Scalenut', page '↳ Icons', frame 'Icon set' (133 components, 16×16). Geometry is the flattened Glyph fill, offset to the 16×16 frame and rounded to 2 decimals. A path starting with ! uses the even-odd fill rule. Paths are separated by |.
_basedOn: IconPark (Apache-2.0), outlined and flattened in Figma
